summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (88/289)

data.turoyo: Komaḥti, konəṣbi ak=kowanaṯṯe w haṯe, i=ḥurmaṯe, kosaymo muklo l aʕ=ʕabidin.
data.translation: Sie machten Rast und schlugen die Zelte auf, und jene Frau bereitete für die Sklaven essen.

rationale: First Infectum box: overt plural tents as direct object, with the stopping-and-cooking context retained.

summary: 36/95 supplies two distinct Preterit tokens in one already quoted example: nṣəbbe with plural agents and nṣəble with singular huwe. Keep exactly two occurrence decisions but do not duplicate the entry example.
88/289 konəṣbi adds an Infectum box, while the nominal object remains tents. Narrative Infectum is rendered with German past tense; the translation tense does not alter the form classification.
The tent-pitching sense already covers čadəre and kowane objects. Neither a new sense nor a separate light-verb collocation is required.
